description: A tiny generic ivory skeleton dungeon monster with a large skull, dark eye sockets, clearly readable ribcage and short limbs. No clothes and no weapons. Cute menacing retro RPG enemy, planted feet, whole body centered in the cell, fits inside24x24 pixels on a32x32 canvas, limited ivory/tan palette and strong black outline, simple readable silhouette matching tiny classic dungeon sprites. Idle standing pose facing southeast.
